planner_json.title: Scaffold .github/workflows/harness-eval.yml: workflow_dispatch (install_mode input, checkout default), empty default permissions, six-harness by two-track smoke matrix (fail-fast false, no cache, keyless install), no banned events

write_prohibited: anything under a root-level harness/ directory

requirements.title: Hand dispatch: maintainer starts the grade by hand, checkout default, same matrix and checks as nightly
requirements.description: GIVEN the harness-eval workflow does not exist on main WHEN the maintainer runs gh workflow run harness-eval with no inputs THEN a run exists with event workflow_dispatch, install_mode checkout, candidate_sha equal to the dispatch commit, and six harnesses including cursor
requirements.verification_service: GitHub Actions harness-eval workflow + real harness CLIs + harness-smoke keys
requirements.positive_example: Dispatch with no inputs creates a run with event workflow_dispatch and install_mode=checkout recorded in the result (same twelve cells, same four checks as the nightly matrix shape) — module exits 0. Explicit published input is accepted and recorded as mode; full published grading resolution lands in sprint-03 by dependency plan (not declined debt).
requirements.red_input: Base main: gh workflow run harness-eval fails with 'could not find any workflows named harness-eval' — the module captures that failure, exits 1, writes .red. Exists today.

scenario.topology_note: workflow_dispatch on main with install_mode input (checkout default); artifact records event, install_mode, candidate_sha; a second dispatch with explicit published records published mode without checkout substitution

would_fail_if: a default (no-input) dispatch recorded install_mode published or a release candidate_sha — the checkout identity is omitted
a published dispatch carried checkout identity — R-mode-mixup guard fires
mode were inferred from logs instead of artifact fields

forms: artifact identity fields (event, install_mode, candidate_sha, plugin_revision)
examples: install_mode checkout with candidate_sha == dispatch commit
published input yields install_mode published, candidate_sha null, could-not-run cells naming release resolution
evidence.required_capture: dispatch commit sha from git and the artifact's candidate_sha for equality, plus both run ids

build_proof.range: anything that proves a real dispatch created a real run whose artifact records the checkout identity
examples: gh workflow run + gh run list row + downloaded harness-eval-result-<RUN_ID>-1

steps: gh workflow run harness-eval with no inputs

must_not_observe: candidate_sha null on the checkout run

must_observe: artifact records install_mode "published" and candidate_sha null
cells honestly read "could-not-run" naming release resolution, never checkout-substituted
must_not_observe: candidate_sha == dispatch commit on the published run
a pass verdict on any published-mode cell in sprint-01 (no graded cells exist there)

requirements.description: The hand-dispatch flow records install_mode checkout when a dispatch passes no install_mode input
The hand-dispatch flow rejects a workflow that declares any of the banned triggers
A default dispatch records event workflow_dispatch and install_mode checkout in the result artifact

seed/live-dispatch-run.entrypoint: gh workflow run harness-eval --repo hackerpug-ai/pixel-perfect (real dispatch, checkout default)
seed/live-dispatch-run.description: RUN_ID + attempt-qualified artifacts via gh run download

planner_json.agent_rationale: Repo platform control work — a real GitHub Actions workflow, its permissions and its triggers — is the surface github-platform-implementer owns per AGENTS.md.

specification.objective: Ship the dispatchable skeleton of `harness-eval` — trigger, permissions, twelve-cell matrix shape, and empty transfer jobs — so a real hand dispatch exists and every later task has a file to extend.
specification.success_state: `gh workflow list --all` shows `harness-eval` active; a no-input dispatch creates a run with `event: workflow_dispatch`; the run page shows a twelve-cell matrix (all six harnesses, `pinned` and `newest`) and the grade-recorder placeholder, with no `pull_request`-family trigger anywhere in the file.

design.pattern: none — headless product; the reader is the result artifact and the Actions summary (UC-GRD-01)

integration_obligations.completion_rule: After T1, T2 and T8 land, replay FLOW-RUN-02-HAND on the trunk: a no-input dispatch must produce a run with event workflow_dispatch, install_mode checkout, candidate_sha equal to the dispatch commit, and six harnesses including cursor.
